claims.statement: Within the collected EDR telemetry window, no process execution on WS-42 matched the deployed detection ruleset.
The reported phishing message was quarantined by the mail gateway before it reached the WS-42 mailbox.
Egress activity from VLAN 30 after 2026-08-02 is unestablished because netflow retention lapsed.

limitations.text: Netflow retention for VLAN 30 lapsed on 2026-08-02; egress activity after that date was not captured and cannot be ruled on.
A no-finding result is scoped to the deployed detection ruleset over the stated window. It is not a certification that the host is uncompromised.
